hardConstraintNote: This move does *not* introduce new claims; it translates existing narrative/poem content into paper form.
rationale: The narrative and poem implicitly establish a reciprocal obligation for mutual aid between participants in the understanding workshop. This is not explicitly stated in the white paper, creating a gap that could lead to misunderstandings or exploitative behavior. Translating this implicit element into formal language strengthens the framework's resilience.
title: Carry the Implicit Contractual Obligation of Mutual Aid
